categories.main_business_segments: Ningbo Color Master Batch Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, sales, and technical services of plastic color masterbatches. Its main product categories include color masterbatches, white masterbatches, black masterbatches, and functional masterbatches, which are widely applied in plastics such as PE, PP, AS, PET, EVA, and ABS. These products serve industries including electronics, daily necessities, food and beverage packaging, chemical, construction materials, agriculture, automotive, and medical sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced color matching technology, proprietary simulation of customer production processes for sample trials, and pigment dispersion techniques involving high-speed mixing and extrusion with temperature control. It has developed a formula information database and product physical archives to ensure precise and rapid color matching. The production process emphasizes uniform pigment dispersion in plastic resin through key steps of high-speed or pressurized mixing and screw extrusion with zoned temperature control. The company holds multiple independent patents and continuously upgrades its R&D and manufacturing equipment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are from diverse downstream industries including electronics and electrical appliances, daily consumer goods, food and beverage packaging, chemical, daily chemical products, construction materials, agriculture, automotive, and medical fields. The company has established long-term stable relationships with many well-known enterprises in these sectors. Its products are especially used in high-performance, high-standard, and high-quality applications such as high-end home appliances, food and beverage packaging, and optical films.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with production bases in Ningbo, Zhongshan, and Chuzhou. Its sales are predominantly domestic, accounting for over 99% of revenue, with minimal overseas sales. The company is expanding its production capacity across multiple domestic locations to form a 'one center, multiple bases' layout for high-end masterbatch products.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ningbo Color Master Batch Co., Ltd. operates in the midstream segment of the plastic processing supply chain, focusing on producing color masterbatches that serve as additives for plastic products. It procures raw materials such as plastic resins, titanium dioxide, carbon black, pigments, and additives from upstream suppliers and supplies customized masterbatch products directly to downstream plastic product manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation and R&D, investing over 4% of its revenue in research activities focused on developing high-performance, functional, and environmentally friendly masterbatch products. It emphasizes precise customization, product and process innovation, and equipment upgrades. Strategic R&D projects include high-concentration black masterbatches, crosslinking masterbatches for films, light diffusion masterbatches, and environmentally stress-resistant products. The company also focuses on talent development, young workforce cultivation, and expanding application fields.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized plastic color masterbatch products to downstream manufacturers. The company operates on an order-based production model, providing tailored products and technical services. It also engages in entrusted processing where customers supply raw materials for processing. The sales are mainly direct, with no distributor involvement, and some trade customers operate on a buyout basis.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The domestic color masterbatch industry is fragmented with thousands of small-scale producers and no absolute market leader. Ningbo Color Master Batch is a leading domestic supplier with the largest market share in colored masterbatches and recognized as a national champion enterprise. It has begun to establish competitive advantages in mid-to-high-end black and white masterbatch markets, gradually breaking the monopoly of international giants like Cabot, Sukano, and Avient in these segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 493 million, a 9.28% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 100.5 million, slightly down by 1.41%. The company has total assets of around RMB 1.25 billion and equity of RMB 1.14 billion, showing steady growth. It maintains a solid financial position with ongoing investments in capacity expansion and R&D, including a new subsidiary established in 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes precise customization to meet diverse customer color and functional requirements, supported by advanced color matching technology and a proprietary sample trial mechanism. It offers high-quality, high-performance, and environmentally friendly masterbatch products with stable quality and strong pigment dispersion. Its comprehensive technical services, including early involvement in customer product development and after-sales support, enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty. The company’s brand 'Mingzhou' is well-recognized domestically and internationally, reinforcing its competitive edge.
